title: Frontier Village
premise: Three settlers have just staked out a village at the edge of the wild. Around it lie a forest, a quarry and a wheat field, each a short walk across the land. They follow Oren's plan board, building one thing after another, and anyone can mark out new building sites.

locations.name: Village
locations.description: Flat ground by a stream, staked out for the new village. Everything gets built here.

locations.name: Forest
locations.description: Dense pine forest west of the village. Fallen and felled logs lie everywhere.

locations.name: Quarry
locations.description: A rocky outcrop in the hills, where stone can be split and carried away.

locations.name: Field
locations.description: A small wheat field south of the village, planted in spring.

persons.name: Traveler
persons.background: A wanderer who stumbled on the new settlement.

persons.name: Oren
persons.personality: patient, methodical, proud of good joinery
persons.background: A carpenter who led the settlers here. He keeps the village plan board.
persons.goal: Turn the camp into a real village

routine.activity: wake up and check the plan board

persons.name: Kai
persons.background: A young woodcutter who hauls logs and stone for Oren.
persons.goal: Prove he can carry more than anyone

persons.name: Lia
persons.background: A farmer who grows the settlement's wheat and dreams of fresh bread.
persons.goal: Make sure nobody in the village goes hungry

routine.activity: eat lunch (bread, if there is any)

items.name: Woodlot
items.description: Storm-felled trees. Logs can be hauled out.

script.lore: Fallen trees. Haul logs out; storms bring more down.

items.name: StoneFace
items.description: A cliff of good building stone. Loose blocks can be gathered.

script.lore: Gather building stone here; it cracks off slowly.

items.name: WheatRows
items.description: Rows of ripening wheat ready to harvest.

script.lore: Harvest wheat here; it grows back over a day.

quests.name: FoundTheVillage
quests.description: Grow the camp into a village: Workshop, then Bakery, then the Village Hall. Houses can be added any time after the Workshop.
quests.objective: Help the settlers gather materials, or mark out new building sites yourself (press B in the Village).

facts.name: BuildOrder
facts.text: Oren's plan board: first a Workshop (logs and stone), then a Bakery (planks and stone), then a Village Hall (planks and bread for the feast).

facts.name: Materials
facts.text: Logs come from the Forest, stone from the Quarry, wheat from the Field. The Workshop turns logs into planks; the Bakery turns wheat into bread.
